fields.description:
Broken road pavement near a school

The road pavement is broken and the asphalt is severely cracked right in front of the elementary school, posing a risk to children and school buses.

Large pothole on a main road

A large, deep pothole has formed in the middle of the main road. It is causing severe traffic slowdowns and is highly dangerous for two-wheelers.

Water leakage from a public pipeline

There is a continuous spray of water leaking from a broken public pipeline onto the street, wasting hundreds of liters of water.

Streetlight not working near a residential street

The streetlight pole has been damaged and the light is not functioning. The street is completely dark at night, raising safety concerns.

Blocked drainage causing water accumulation

The street drainage is completely blocked with debris and plastics. Dirty water is accumulating around it and might overflow soon.
Pothole on MG Road near Metro Pillar 42

Garbage overflowing near a residential area

There is a massive overflow of garbage at the main bin located near the residential society. The smell is unbearable and it's attracting stray animals.
Pothole on MG Road near Metro Pillar 42

Damaged public park bench

A wooden bench in the public park has been severely damaged and broken, making it unusable for visitors.
